title: Asymptotic solutions: glancing trajectories, Lagrangian singularities, and Bessel cylinders
summary: We find a normal form for the simplest Lagrangian singularity appearing as the projection onto the space-energy of a solution to the Hamilton-Jacobi equation. Using this normal form we approximate asymptotic solutions of an equation $(\widehat{H}-E_0) \, u_h = f_h$ with a semiclassical distribution $f_h$ microlocalized on a Lagrangian manifold $Λ_0$ when $E_0$ is a critical value of the restriction $H|_{Λ_0}$.
